answers.core: It modifies the APIs for Label and/or RichTextLabel, which I don't believe is possible via an add-on.
answers.workaround: As far as I know, the current workaround would be to use a RichTextLabel and create a custom RichTextEffect for it, then write your logic in `RichTextEffect._process_custom_fx()`. Then, in the RichTextLabel itself, you need to add at least an opening tag for your custom effect.

title: Add API to access characters in Label or RichTextLabel
